controls.title: Accountability: roles and responsibilities for AI risk are assigned and documented
Context: intended purpose, setting and expected users are understood and recorded
Third-party components: risks from external models, data and software are mapped
Impacts: likelihood and size of impacts on people and organisations are characterised
Evaluation: the system is tested for trustworthiness characteristics, with results recorded
Treatment: risks are prioritised and a response is decided and recorded
Monitoring: risk treatments, incidents and recovery are monitored after deployment
